profile.name: Marlou Kong
profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer • Excel VBA Automation • POS Systems
profile.about: Developer focused on building usable business software—from Excel VBA systems to modern web applications, databases, and cloud deployment.

experiences.description: Designing and building operational software for small businesses and organizations, with emphasis on POS workflows, reporting, inventory, automation, and maintainable administration tools.
bullets: Built POS workflows with role-based controls, payment handling, sales logs, and reporting.
Automated inventory deduction, replenishment, transfers, costing, and audit logs.
Migrated spreadsheet-driven workflows toward deployable web applications.

experiences.description: Created advanced Excel applications with dynamic forms, structured data sheets, PDF exports, automated email reports, backups, restore tools, and dashboards.
bullets: Developed dynamic product and ingredient management interfaces.
Created daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly reporting workflows.
Implemented backup, restore, logging, costing, and stock validation logic.

projects.title: Coffee Shop POS System
projects.description: A full business system covering orders, product availability, ingredient-level inventory, promos, costing, transfers, replenishment, backups, PDF reports, and transaction audit logs.

projects.title: Laundry POS Web Application
projects.description: A modern POS application designed around React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, role-based access, business logic, testing, GitHub, and Railway deployment.

projects.title: Parish Website & Management Experience
projects.description: A parish-focused website concept with editable brand content, contact information, leadership hierarchy, profile photos, and organization management.

timeline.title: Expanded into full-stack web development
timeline.text: Started converting operational systems from spreadsheet-based workflows into deployable web applications using modern frontend, backend, database, GitHub, and Railway tooling.

timeline.title: Completed advanced POS reporting automation
timeline.text: Built automated sales reports with product aggregation, transaction logs, costing visibility, PDF generation, and email delivery workflows.

timeline.title: Developed inventory and costing systems
timeline.text: Implemented ingredient-level stock control, product availability logic, transfer and replenishment tracking, promo rules, and operational dashboards.
